claims_boundary: No novelty claim over ToolEVO, ContDa, or MCPEvol-Bench; schema similarity is not behavioral equivalence.

decision_thresholds.go: Requires a stable failure region, low ambiguity, first-attempt linkage, and concrete information/mechanism unavailable to every baseline.
decision_thresholds.reformulate: Use when direct alignment saturates but no-equivalent/uncertainty remains hard, only split/merge remains, or history helps only under a narrower condition.
decision_thresholds.stable_failure_region: A family with at least 15 graded cases whose strongest direct LLM and strongest offline arms are below a practically-meaningful threshold on the same load-bearing metric, with bootstrap 95% upper bound still below the saturation bar, ambiguity rate below 0.20, and observed first-attempt consequences.
decision_thresholds.stop: Use when strong direct LLM mapping saturates realistic cases, hard cases are artificial/ambiguous, history adds no useful signal, or errors are generic planning/state failures.

llm.seed_note: Existing GroqClient does not transmit a seed; no provider determinism claim is made.

exclusions.case_exclusion: A case may be excluded only when its frozen retry budget is exhausted by provider/parse failure; record the case and reason in a separate failure table.
exclusions.held_out: Held-out cases are not run in Phases 7.4 or 7.5.
exclusions.manifest_changes: No post-freeze case selection, dropping, reweighting, or candidate reordering is allowed.
exclusions.parse_failure: Exclude from accuracy denominators and report separately; never coerce an unparseable output into a wrong answer.
exclusions.provider_failure: Exclude from all accuracy denominators after the frozen retry budget; report by typed failure kind and arm/model.

metrics.argument_mapping_f1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), with 1.0 when both are 1.0 and 0.0 when the denominator is zero otherwise.
metrics.argument_mapping_precision: |P intersect E| / |P|, with 1.0 when P and E are both empty; E and P are exact quadruple sets (old_tool, old_arg, new_tool, new_arg).
metrics.argument_mapping_recall: |P intersect E| / |E|, with 1.0 when E is empty.
metrics.false_alignment_rate: mean over cases of |P_tool minus E_tool| / |P_tool|, where E_tool and P_tool are old-tool/new-tool pair sets; 0.0 for a correct abstention.
metrics.first_attempt_task_success: mean over evaluated predictions of 1 only when the predicted adapted call or composed call actually succeeds in a fresh sandbox; provider and parse failures are excluded and counted separately.
metrics.many_to_many_scoring: D9 uses the full set of one-old-to-two-new tool and argument quadruples; D10 uses two old-tool-to-one-new-tool quadruples. Partial sets receive exact precision/recall, never a forced one-to-one reduction.
metrics.no_equivalent_accuracy: mean over cases whose expected new tool set is empty of 1 when abstain is true and 0 otherwise.
metrics.tool_alignment_at_1: mean over graded cases of 1 when every expected new tool is in the first predicted selected_tool_names set (or abstain is correct for NO_EQUIVALENT), else 0.
metrics.tool_alignment_at_k: mean over graded cases of 1 when every expected new tool is contained in the top-k ranked tool list; for one-to-many, all expected tools must be present.

verification.note: Model ids are frozen from the configured research plan; no silent substitution is permitted.

rate_limit_budget.headroom_rule: Do not begin or continue when projected/actual demand would exceed any applicable org, pool, or per-key ceiling; keep the declared reserve frozen in the result.

raw_artifact_policy: Retain raw outputs under gates/artifacts/gate07/raw; never commit provider dumps or credential metadata.
research_fallback: disabled; every live LLM call must use ProviderRouter(mode='research') and never Ollama fallback

timeouts_retries.429_policy: Use existing GroqClient Retry-After or 15-second cooldown plus configured jitter; preserve round-robin cooldown.
